title: Cast Iron vs. Schedule 40 PVC for Drainage
description: Selecting the proper material for Drain, Waste, and Vent (DWV) systems depends on acoustic requirements, fire ratings, and structural demands. Cast iron pipe offers superior sound damping, making it the preferred choice for vertical stacks in multi-story residential buildings where water noise must be minimized. It is also non-combustible and highly durable under physical load. In contrast, Schedule 40 PVC is lightweight, cost-effective, and immune to metallic corrosion, but transmits significantly more fluid sound. Understanding these material characteristics ensures optimal performance based on specific building requirements.
